transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I feel like I’ve got a motor running inside me all day. If I have to sit still—at church, here at the clinic, even at home—I start feeling trapped. I have to get up or do something.
Are you currently taking any prescription medications?
No, I’m not taking any prescription medicine right now.
Did you experience this same restlessness when you were a child?
Yeah, definitely. In school they were always moving my seat because I couldn’t stay put. I’d talk out of turn and get in trouble for jumping up before class was over.
Do you also struggle with keeping your attention focused on tasks or conversations?
Yeah. I’ll be listening when people are going over ride times, pantry lists, or church plans, and I’m good at first. Then my mind kind of slips away, and I miss parts I really needed to hear.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others or blurting out answers before someone has finished speaking?
Yeah, I do. I’ll jump in with an answer before the pastor, my cousin, or the pantry lady is finished talking. Then sometimes I realize I answered the wrong thing, or I’ve made them mad.
